examples: Do you know how to drive?
We want to rent a flat near the beach.
Where can I park the car?
I like chatting with my grandma.
I take the bus at eight.
Take an umbrella, it's going to rain.
note: An everyday verb in Spain: coger el metro, coger un taxi, coger el teléfono. In Mexico it is vulgar; there people say tomar or agarrar.

examples: I don't feel like going out today.
note: Like gustar: me apetece, te apetece, nos apetecen las vacaciones.
Colloquial, like gustar: me mola, nos molan los conciertos. ¡Mola! = That is cool!
suspender un examen = to fail an exam, the opposite is aprobar. It also means to call off: han suspendido el partido.

examples: Turn right at the traffic lights.

note: fregar los platos = to do the dishes, fregar el suelo = to mop the floor, la fregona = mop.
